info.name: Patient Management Service API
info.description:
REST API collection for the Patient Management Service (port 8081). Covers full patient CRUD and medical record operations.

Set the `baseUrl` collection variable to point at your running instance (default: http://localhost:8081).

variable.description: Base URL of the running Patient Management Service

item.name: Patients
item.description: Full CRUD operations for patient resources

request.description: Retrieve the list of all registered patients. Returns 200 OK with an array of patients (empty array when none exist).
Retrieve a single patient by ID. Returns 200 OK with the patient, or 404 Not Found if the patient does not exist.

Register a new patient. Returns 201 Created with the persisted patient (including generated ID). Returns 400 Bad Request on validation errors and 409 Conflict when the email or SSN is already registered.

body.raw:
{
    "firstName": "John",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "dateOfBirth": "1985-03-15",
    "email": "john.doe@example.com",
    "phone": "+1-555-987-6543",
    "address": "456 Oak Avenue, Springfield, IL 62702",
    "ssn": "123-45-6789",
    "bloodType": "O+",
    "allergies": "Penicillin, Peanuts, Dust"
}

request.description: Update an existing patient by ID. All fields are replaced with the values supplied. Returns 200 OK with the updated patient, 404 Not Found if the patient does not exist, or 409 Conflict on duplicate email/SSN.
Delete a patient by ID. Returns 204 No Content on success, or 404 Not Found if the patient does not exist.

item.name: Medical Records
item.description: Medical record operations scoped to a patient

request.description: Retrieve all medical records for a patient, ordered by record date (most recent first). Returns 200 OK with an array of records, or 404 Not Found if the patient does not exist.

body.raw:
{
    "recordDate": "2024-05-10",
    "diagnosis": "Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus",
    "treatment": "Metformin 500mg twice daily, dietary counseling",
    "notes": "Patient advised on blood glucose monitoring. Follow-up in 3 months.",
    "physician": "Dr. Sarah Johnson"
}

request.description: Add a new medical record to a patient. The patientId is taken from the path; it does not need to be in the body. Returns 201 Created with the persisted record, 400 Bad Request on validation errors, or 404 Not Found if the patient does not exist.
